description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing module, focusing on parsing and selecting provider configurations for talk payloads, including handling normalized and legacy formats.

classes.name: TalkConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A struct containing test functions to verify the behavior of TalkConfigParsing related to talk provider configurations.

methods.name: prefersCanonicalResolvedTalkProviderPayload
methods.description: Tests that selectProviderConfig correctly recognizes a canonical resolved payload with provider 'elevenlabs' and verifies payload normalization.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Tests rejection of normalized payloads lacking a 'resolved' key.

methods.name: fallsBackToLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Verifies fallback to legacy fields when normalized payload configurations are missing.

methods.name: canDisableLegacyFallback
methods.description: Checks that legacy fallback can be disabled via allowLegacyFallback parameter.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenProviderMissingFromProviders
methods.description: Ensures rejection when a provider in normalized payloads does not exist in providers list.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenMultipleProvidersAndNoProvider
methods.description: Verifies rejection of normalized payloads when multiple providers exist but no specific provider is selected.

methods.name: bridgesFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Test that a Foundation-style dictionary is correctly bridged into a Swift dictionary with proper typings.

methods.name: resolvesPositiveIntegerTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that positive integer timeouts are correctly resolved with fallback values when invalid.
